meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交、变基、搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Git 管理代码版本
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits, rebase, and search history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Git for version control

howto.what: 它会把代码改动拆成多个有逻辑的小提交(测试跟实现放一起),模仿仓库原有提交风格;还能重写提交历史(rebase/squash),并搜索某段代码是何时、由谁引入的。
howto.when: 当用户提到“commit”“rebase”“squash”等词,或询问某段代码是谁写的、何时添加时触发。

say.text: 把当前改动按模块拆成多个小提交
say.note: 会先输出风格分析和提交计划再执行

say.text: 帮我 rebase 并 squash 这些提交
say.note: 会启动历史重写流程,处理冲突

say.text: 查一下这段代码是谁写的、什么时候加的
say.note: 会进入历史搜索模式定位引入点

howto.what_en: Splits changes into atomic commits with tests, mirrors repo commit style, does rebase/squash history rewrite, and finds when code was introduced.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', or asks who wrote / when a change was added.

say_en.text: Split the current changes into logical commits by module.
say_en.note: It prints the style analysis and commit plan first.

say_en.text: Rebase and squash these commits for me.
say_en.note: It starts the history rewrite flow and handles conflicts.

say_en.text: Find who wrote this code and when it was added.
say_en.note: It enters history search mode to locate the origin.
